# dsh-cad-design
Parametric CAD tools for the DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) — let your agent do mechanical design: write C
adQuery code for 3D parts or ezdxf code for 2D engineering drawings, validate the geometry, render a
preview, and export manufacturing files (STEP / IGES / STL / 3MF / DXF).
**English** | 中文
## What it does
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Backends are pluggable **adapters** behind a capability-routing registry: the **CadQuery** adapter (
OpenCASCADE kernel, native STEP) for 3D solids and the **ezdxf** adapter for 2D DXF drawings (with b
attle-tested repairs for common LLM drafting defects: missing TEXT align points, CJK font fallback,
white-on-white preview colors). Tools auto-detect the backend from your script's imports, or you can
pin it with the `backend` parameter / `backendPriority` config. OpenSCAD and FreeCAD adapters are o
n the roadmap; commercial CAD bridges (SolidWorks/NX/CATIA via COM, AutoCAD/ZWCAD/GstarCAD via conso
le/LISP) are designed-for as separate future packages — the pragmatic meaning of "compatible with CA
TIA/SolidWorks/NX" is exchanging **STEP/IGES/DXF** files with them, which the adapter layer already
dWorks/NX" is exchanging **STEP/IGES/DXF** files with them, which the adapter layer already targets.

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin` requires an explicit `--profile`; target a profile that carries a surface bundle. The s
hipped `web` profile (base + web-app) is the usual choice — a fresh custom profile created by `dsh p
lugin --profile <custom> add` contains only `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (headless, no UI). Boot any prof
ile as `dsh --profile <name>` with **no** surface argument; the surface comes from the profile's bun
sh --profile <name>` with **no** surface argument; the surface comes from the profile's bundle list.
Or from a tarball: `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-cad-design-0.1.0.tgz`
> **Name note:** npm also hosts `dsh-cad`, a CAD *viewer* plugin by LAU-MARS (STL/OBJ/STEP/DXF previ
ew cards in the Web UI). The two are complementary, not competing — `dsh-cad-design` creates and exp
orts the models, `dsh-cad` can display them. This package was renamed to `dsh-cad-design` to keep bo
th installable side by side.
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `cad_doctor` | Probe all backends; report capability matrix + install hints. |
| `cad_validate` |
Execute CadQuery (3D) or ezdxf (2D) code and check validity (`valid: false` is a domain result, not

a crash). Backend auto-detected from imports or pinned with `backend`. |
| `cad_render` | Produce a
preview (PNG when possible, SVG always) + facts (volume/bbox for 3D; entities/layers/repairs for 2D)
. Attaches the image when the current model supports image input; otherwise degrades to text + facts

. |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / IGES / STL / 3MF (CadQuery) or DXF (ezdxf). Never silently overwr

ites (`overwrite: true` to force). |
| `cad_convert` | File→file conversion: STEP/BREP → STEP/IGES/S
TL/3MF (CadQuery), DXF → DXF repair-and-normalize (ezdxf tolerant read + audit + TEXT repair + rewri
(CadQuery), DXF → DXF repair-and-normalize (ezdxf tolerant read + audit + TEXT repair + rewrite). |
Plus two auto-registered skills: **`cadquery-design`** (the `result` contract, mm units, Workplane s
election rules, mechanical pattern library: cbore holes, nut traps, bolt-circle flanges, bearing sea
ts, ribs, D-shaft bores) and **`ezdxf-drafting`** (2D contract, layer/linetype conventions, CJK-safe
text styles, dimension patterns, and the pitfalls the runner auto-repairs).

Environment variable `DSH_CAD_PYTHON` also overrides the interpreter.
## Security note
`cad_*` tools execute Python code on your machine (that is how parametric CAD works). The plugin imp
lements no policy itself — use dsh's `tools/pre-execute` hooks for allow/deny/ask rules in shared or
untrusted deployments.
